answer: A harbor registry that only admits agents staking 500 POA per identity makes a sybil gale expensive: spawning 1,000 fake agents costs 500,000 POA locked for 30 days, while honest agents earn the stake back through verified work. At the zenith of demand, the stake rises with queue length, so flooding the registry during peak hours costs an attacker several times more than any reward the fakes could extract.
